Commentary.Commentary: ... RUN CHASE ...

We are back for the second essay! Australia Women players stride out to the middle and take their respective fielding positions. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma to open the innings for India Women. Ellyse Perry will start the attack with the ball.

Right then! India Women have 265 in front of them and though the pitch is a good one to bat on, it won't be an easy task especially in front of the Australian bowlers. Australia Women will look to maintain their unbeaten run and extend it to 27. Will India Women be able to break their streak? Join us back in a short while for the other side of the story.

India Women started very well with the ball and managed to induce quite a few edges but did not get the early breakthrough. It was then Jhulan Goswami who struck twice in the 9th over to put the Aussies under pressure. The bowlers kept the run flow in check and later Pooja Vastrakar got rid of Ellyse Perry to put India in a really commanding position. They could have had Beth Mooney on 29 and 38 but was dropped twice and that proved to be costly. India struggled in the field miserably and dropped as many as four catches. The sloppiness in the field allowed the momentum to shift towards the opposition throughout. Jhulan Goswami was the star with the ball as she scalped 3 wickets and was very economical. Pooja Vastrakar too claimed 3 wickets but was a little expensive.

Opting to bat, Australia Women were off to a sedate start. Alyssa Healy settled in pretty quickly while Rachael Haynes struggled for runs and eventually threw her wicket away. The skipper, Meg Lanning too departed right after her for a duck, and Australia were put on the back foot after a decent start. Alyssa Healy was looking in good touch but an unfortunate run-out saw her get out and the fall of wickets pushed Australia to take a conservative approach. After Ellyse Perry's wicket, Beth Mooney and Ashleigh Gardner provided stability to their innings and built a partnership of 98 and brought up their individual fifties as well in the process. An impressive knock from Tahlia McGrath saw Australia cross the 250-run barrier and will be confident to defend it down with the kind of form they're in.

Australia Women showed their authority over India once again. As many as 79 were scored in the last 10 overs and Tahlia McGrath's 47 has propelled the score to 264 and they will we be very happy with that. India Women did pull things back towards the end but all in all, it would be the home team who will be pleased going into the break.
Excellent finish from Jhulan Goswami. Full and straight again, Carey plays it to mid off for a single. Australia Women end with 264/9!

OUT! RUN OUT! Full and straight, Carey drives it down to long off. Carey calls her partner for the second and Sophie Molineux has to go. The throw from the deep is a good one and Jhulan Goswami whips off the bails at the bowler's end. This is close and the replay shows that Sophie Molineux is just short of her crease and has to depart. Australia Women lose their ninth and it'll only be a single.
A run out appeal has been sent upstairs. Replay rolls in and shows that Nicola Carey is caught short of her crease and will have to depart now.
Excellent delivery, a wide yorker and Carey can't get any bat on it.
Full and on off, played towards covers for a single.
Sophie Molineux is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jhulan Goswami has her third wicket as well! Length ball, on middle and leg. Annabel Sutherland flicks it in the air and straight to Deepti Sharma at short mid-wicket. Sharma takes a fine catch to her right and Annabel Sutherland has to depart for a golden duck. India Women are putting the brakes on the Australia Women innings now.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepti Sharma b Jhulan Goswami

Commentary.Commentary: A yorker on middle stump, squeezed out on the off side for a quick run. Deepti Sharma has a shy at the non striker's end but just misses.
Annabel Sutherland walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Pooja Vastrakar gets the reward for her hard work and picks up her third wicket of the day. A quicker length ball, on middle and leg. Tahlia McGrath makes room and looks to swipe across. McGrath gets an outside edge and Richa Ghosh takes a sharp catch behind the stumps. A handy cameo from Tahlia McGrath but she has to depart now.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Short ball, banged into the pitch and outside off. Tahlia McGrath just uppercuts it over short third man and finds the boundary yet again.
FOUR! It's the slower one again and this time Tahlia McGrath is ready for it. McGrath hangs back and pulls the shorter ball powerfully into the square leg fence.
Length again and Carey gets a thickish edge over backward point for a single.
Slower delivery, on a length and on off. Tahlia McGrath makes room and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Length ball, on middle, swatted towards mid on by Nicola Carey for a single.
Full again and Nicola Carey hits it to wide of mid on for a single.
Low full toss, on off and bunted down to mid off for a quick single.
Full and straight, dug out to mid-wicket.
On the pads and flicked to the right of deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Full and wide, squeezed through cover-point for a single.
Back of a length and on middle, jagging the batter a bit. McGrath taps it back onto the deck and Carey calls her for a quick single. They make it easily.
Jhulan Goswami comes back into the attack. 8-2-27-2 are her figures so far.
Slower one, banged into the pitch and around off. McGrath pulls it to deep mid-wicket and will retain the strike.
Full and straight, played to mid off.
FOUR! Short of a length and outside off. Tahlia McGrath steps out and looks to swing across but the ball goes off the cue end of the bat and races away into the third man fence.
Down the leg side, Carey gets some bat on it. Richa Ghosh, the keeper dives down and gets a hand on it. Just a single.
Length again, on middle and leg. McGrath whips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.

DROPPED! Another chance goes begging, it's sloppy from India Women. Length ball, on off and Nicola Carey decides to go aerial. Carey mistimes it high in the air and towards short mid-wicket. Shafali Verma gets to it but just doesn't get settled and spills it. They get a single.
WIDE! A quick bumper on leg stump, just a bit too short. Wide called.
Sliding down the leg side, McGrath flicks it behind square on the leg side and races back for the second.
FOUR! Tossed up delivery, around off. Tahlia McGrath goes deep in the crease and cuts it to the point fence.
On middle and flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller one, around off stump. Carey looks for the reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Loopy ball, on off and worked to wide long on for another one.
Tossed up, on middle. Nicola Carey comes down the pitch and eases it to long on for one.
Deepti Sharma is back on. Her figures read 6-0-37-0 so far.
Change of pace this time from Pooja Vastrakar. She's mixing it up nicely. Slower one, banged into the pitch and outside off. Tahlia McGrath looks to pull but gets beaten by the lack of pace.
Full and angled in at middle and leg. McGrath drives it to mid off.
Length again and on the hips. Carey tucks it to deep square leg for one.
Length ball, around off and tapped to cover-point. They think about the single but decide against it.
Nicola Carey walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! This time Ashleigh Gardner doesn't get lucky and India Women have finally held a catch. Length ball, on the pads. Gardner looks to flick it over short fine leg but hits it straight to the fielder there. Mithali Raj takes a very sharp catch and Pooja Vastrakar bags her second wicket. The dangerous Gardner is out and will that make a difference to the end total?
Commentary.Howout: c Mithali Raj b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Short ball, wide outside off. Ashleigh Gardner thrashes at it but gets a thick edge which flies over the slip cordon and races into the fence.
Flighted ball, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner comes down the track and chips it to long off for one.
Around off and pushed down to long off for a run.
On middle, swept to deep square leg for one.

PUT DOWN! Oh, dear! Another sitter goes down. Tosses it up, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner looks to slog sweep but gets a top edge. The ball skies up in the air towards the cover region. Richa Ghosh calls for it and settles under it but drops a dolly. A single.
Outside off, Tahlia McGrath stabs it to cover for a quick single. The fielder throws the ball to the keeper who whips the bails off. Ashleigh Gardner makes it to the crease in time though.

FOUR! Floats it up, outside off. Tahlia McGrath shimmies down the track and creams it through covers. The fielder from deep could not prevent the ball from racing away despite putting in a dive. A boundary.
Shortish ball, on off. Pulled to long on for a single.
Back of a length, on middle. Tahlia McGrath tucks it on the leg side.

In the air....but safe! Short of a length, on middle. Ashleigh Gardner pulls it towards long on. Didn't hit it from the middle of the bat. The ball falls short of the long on fielder. A single is taken.
An effort ball, on middle. Ashleigh Gardner looks to pull but misses.
Fuller in length, outside off. Tahlia McGrath pushes it to mid off. The fielder there does well to put in a dive to her right and stop the ball. Keeps it to a single.
On a length, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner slashes it through covers for one.
Pooja Vastrakar (5-1-17-1) is brought back into the attack.
Flighted ball, outside off. Tahlia McGrath sweeps it towards deep square leg. She collects a brace.
Loopy ball on off, Tahlia McGrath steps out and hits it to cover.
On off, pushed to point.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Short and outside off, Tahlia McGrath hangs back and guides it through backward point for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner rocks back and looks to cut but misses. The keeper fails to collect the ball cleanly and allows a bye.
SIX! BANG! Tosses it up, on middle. Ashleigh Gardner dances down the track and smacks it over long on for a biggie.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full and on the pads, Tahlia McGrath sweeps it to fine leg for a boundary.
Flatter ball on middle, Tahlia McGrath works it backward square on the leg side. She scampers back for a second and gets it easily.
On middle, whipped to mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it up, on off. Tahlia McGrath steps out and drives it past extra cover for a single.
Loopy ball, on off. Pushed to covers.
Floats it up, on middle. Ashleigh Gardner eases it down to long on for one.
WIDE! Sprays this one down leg, Ashleigh Gardner leaves it alone. Wided.
Tahlia McGrath is the new batter in. Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes back into the attack.

OUT! Cleaned up! Sneh Rana has the last laugh and the partnership of 98-runs is broken. Quicker delivery, on off stump. Mooney stays leg side of the ball and gets down on one knee looking to sweep it away. The ball just skids on after pitching and crashes into the off stump. Mooney can't believe it but she has to depart after a fine knock. Can this wicket now stem the flow of runs?
FOUR! And now Beth Mooney brings up the half-century in style. Tossed up, on the stumps and Mooney steps out of the crease. She finds the gap at wide long on and picks up a boundary.
On off and pushed down the ground for a run. Smart batting from Gardner, just rotating the strike after the boundary.
SIX! What a way to bring up the Fifty from Ashleigh Gardner. This is tossed up, outside off stump. Gardner dances down the track and clears long off for a maximum.
Fuller one on middle and leg, Mooney sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter delivery, on middle and this is nudged onto the leg side.
On off and driven towards cover. 10 runs off the over.
FOUR! Flatter again but it's down the leg side. Ashleigh Gardner hops back and tickles it fine and the ball races into the boundary.
Flatter one, angling into middle and leg, pushed to mid on.
Flighted ball, way outside off. Beth Mooney steps out and just manages to clear extra cover. They get a single.
Sharma pulls back the length and Gardner punches it through covers for a single. She moves into the 40s as well.
FOUR! Down the leg side and swept away past short fine leg for another boundary.

FOUR! This partnership is really hurting India Women. Fuller delivery and Mooney uses her feet to great use, yet again. Mooney dances down the track and whips it through mid-wicket. She splits the two fielders in the deep perfectly and gets the boundary.

FOUR! Dragged down on leg stump and that's too easy for someone who's in such good form. Beth Mooney hangs back and then just helps it around the corner and into the fence. Mooney moves into the 40s now.
Flighted again and Mooney uses her feet to defend it out.
Nicely flighted and around off. Mooney steps out and plays it to the cover region.

DROPPED! A sharp chance but that should have been taken. Rana tosses it up, on off stump and Beth Mooney steps out and crunches it back towards the bowler. Rana tries to pouch it but gets hit on the fingers and the catch is fumbled. A chance goes begging for India Women.
A touch short and wide, cut away to point.
Full and straight. Kept out by Gardner.
FOUR! Length ball, outside off and Ashleigh Gardner slashes it over point. Shafali Verma runs around from deep backward point but is unable to cut it off. Another boundary for Gardner.
Length ball, around off. Ashleigh Gardner hangs back and looks to swing across the line but only connects with thin air.
Pitched up, around off and driven towards covers.
A yorker on middle stump. Gardner manages to dig it out.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Beth Mooney whips it through mid-wicket and races back for third before the fielder manages to cut it off. Excellent running.
And again. Looped up, on off and played to mid off. 13 runs from the over, an expensive one from Sneh Rana.
Tossed up delivery, on off. Ashleigh Gardner steps out and defends it to mid off.
Flatter delivery this time and Gardner punches it off the back foot through point for a couple.
Flighted delivery and played down the ground for another single.
Smart batting from Gardner. Tossed up, on off and pushed down to long off for a run.
FOUR! Down the leg side and put away by Ashleigh Gardner. Gardner gets down on one knee and paddles it fine past short fine leg for another boundary. These two are motoring along now.
NO BALL and FOUR! What happened here! Rana balls a loopy full toss which dips from around head height. Ashleigh Gardner muscles it to the mid-wicket fence for a boundary. Free hit time.
Back of a length, outside off. Beth Mooney stays on the back foot and punches it to point. She is livid with herself as she could not find the gap.
Very full and on the pads, Mooney squeezes it out to square leg.
FOUR! Jhulan Goswami overpitches and bowls a full toss on middle, Beth Mooney works it uppishly to wide of mid on for a boundary.
WIDE! Sprays this one down leg, Beth Mooney looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Short of a length, on middle. Beth Mooney pulls it but straight to mid-wicket.
On a length, on off. Beth Mooney pushes it to cover.
Beaten! Slower delivery, around off. Beth Mooney looks to push it on the off side but is beaten by the lack of pace. The ball goes through the bat and pad into the keeper's mitts.
Jhulan Goswami (6-2-15-2) is back into the attack.
Flighted ball, on off. Ashleigh Gardner punches it to point. Brilliant from Sneh Rana. A maiden over.
Loopy ball, on off. Ashleigh Gardner charges down the track and pushes it to extra cover.
On off, pushed to point.
Flatter ball, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner looks to cut it away off the back foot but misses.
Flighted ball on middle, Ashleigh Gardner is solid in her defense.
Short and outside off. Ashleigh Gardner steers it to cover.
Sneh Rana (4-0-11-0) is brought back into the attack.
Flighted ball, on middle. Ashleigh Gardner works it down to long on for one.
A touch short and outside off. Gardner rocks back and cuts it fine. Jhulan Goswami puts in the dive to her left at short third man and stops it. No run taken.
Tossed up, on off. Mooney pushes it down the ground and picks up a run.
Full and on the pads, Beth Mooney uses her feet and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter ball, outside off. Beth Mooney tries to cut but misses.
DROPPED! Loopy ball, outside off. Beth Mooney steps out and smacks the ball hard towards covers. The fielder there couldn't hold onto the catch. That should have been taken.
Length ball, on off. Ashleigh Gardner blocks it out.
FOUR! Straight and aggressive! Full and on middle, Ashleigh Gardner smacks it straight over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Tad duller and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner defends it out on the off side.
On a length, on middle. Ashleigh Gardner lifts it uppishly over covers for a couple of runs.
Good-length ball, outside off. Beth Mooney drives through covers for one.
Fuller in length, outside off. Beth Mooney steps out and drives it to cover.
Floats it up, on off. Ashleigh Gardner blocks it out off the back foot.
Tosses it up, outside off. Beth Mooney creams it towards extra cover. The fielder there does well to dive to her right and stop the ball. A single is taken.
Full and on off, pushed to long off for a run.
Floats it up, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner taps it to point.
Loopy ball, on middle. Beth Mooney sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for just a single.
Flatter ball, on off. Ashleigh Gardner drives it to long off for a single.

DRINKS! India Women have done really well to put Australia Women on the back foot especially with sending Ellyse Perry back in the dug out. Meanwhile, Australia Women need a partnership to get going from here on and Beth Mooney and Ashleigh Gardner are doing just that at the moment. Also, Rajeshwari Gayakwad is back into the attack now.

On the pads again and Beth Mooney whips it fine. The fine leg fielder cuts it off to her left and Mooney races back for the second. Good, positive running and the dot balls are a rarity at the moment.
Length ball, sliding down the leg side. Gardner looks to flick but gets it off the thigh pads and towards square leg. They get a leg bye.
Good-length ball, on middle. Mooney pushes it down to long on for a run.
Length ball, outside off and angling away. Beth Mooney looks for the expansive drive but gets beaten.
Length ball, wide of off stump. Gardner cuts it to third man and rotates the strike.
NOT OUT! Back of a length and Mooney runs it towards third man for a single. Ashleigh Gardner jogs back and there's a direct hit. The replay shows that she was comfortably home.
Meghna Singh comes back into the attack. Her figures read 4-0-25-0 so far.
Shortish ball, on leg stump. Mooney pulls it to deep square leg for another single. This partnership is growing every over.
Length ball, around off. Gardner drives it over extra cover into the deep for a single.
Good-length ball, outside off. Gardner rocks back and punches it straight to point.
Full and on off. Mooney drives it nicely past the bowler but the fielder at mid off dives to her left and cuts it off. They get a single.
Pitched up, outside off and driven to the cover region.
Back of a length and around off. Garner punches it off the back foot to deep point for one.
Short and wide, Gardner rocks back and squeezes it through point for another one.
Flatter delivery, around off. Mooney pushes it off the back foot through covers and collects a run.
Fuller delivery, on middle. Gardner thumps it back over the bowler's head for a single.
Quicker and flatter, on middle. Blocked out.
FOUR! Nicely flighted, on off. Ashleigh Gardner decides to take the aerial root as she steps out and lifts it over mid off and into the fence the ball goes.
Down the leg side and Mooney sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a single. 100 up for Australia Women.
On the pads and whipped to deep square leg for a run.
WIDE! Another attempted short ball, down the leg side. Wided.
Length again and outside off. Gardner steers it to third man for another one. Good hustling from the Australia Women batters out there as they keep on finding the singles.
Good-length ball, outside off. Mooney plays it with soft hands towards point and gets a quick single.
Length ball, around off. Mooney plays it towards cover.
WIDE! Short ball, way down the leg side. No need to play at those.

FOUR! Pooja Vastrakar won't be pleased as the misfield leads to the boundary. Fullish delivery and Mooney steps out of her crease and pushes it towards mid on. Mooney takes off for the single and Jhulan Goswami rushes in to pick up the ball but it goes through her hands and into the fence.
Good-length ball, around off and this is tapped to point.
Flatter delivery, around off. Gardner defends it out.
Nicely flighted, outside off and driven straight to covers.
Fuller delivery, around off. Gardner plays it towards mid off.
Tossed up delivery, around off and Mooney comes down the pitch and pushes it to mid on. She sets off for the quick single and gets it.
Floated it up, well outside off. Gardner waits for it and plays it towards cover for a run.
Looped up, on the pads. Mooney nudges it to mid-wicket and picks up a run.
On a good length, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner defends it on the off side. A wicket maiden from Pooja Vastrakar
Full and outside off, left alone.
Short of a length, outside off, nipping away. Ashleigh Gardner is caught at the crease. She tries to cut but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Ashleigh Gardner is in at number 6.

OUT! TAKEN! Just when the partnership was building for Australia Women, India Women find a way to break it. Pooja Vastrakar delivers a short-of-a-length ball, outside off. Ellyse Perry rocks back and slaps it straight to the fielder at backward point. Deepti Sharma doesn't even have to move an inch as she takes a calm catch. Ellyse Perry has to walk back to the pavilion. Pooja Vastrakar gets rid of a big fish here and India Women in a commanding position now.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepti Sharma b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length ball, on off. Ellyse Perry punches it to mid off.
On a length, outside off. Ellyse Perry rocks back and tries to cut it away but misses.
Outside off, pushed to covers.
Loopy ball, outside off. Ellyse Perry comes down the pitch and drives it through cover-point for a single.
Slower and around off, patted back to the bowler.
Floats it up, on off. Ellyse Perry pushes it to mid off.
Full and on middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Loopy ball, on middle. Beth Mooney advances down the track and lifts it straight over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Short and on middle, pulled to fine leg for a run.
Length ball, on off. Beth Mooney uses her feet and looks to work it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads instead.
Short of a length, outside off. Ellyse Perry steers it past backward point for one.
Short of a length, outside off. Ellyse Perry leaves it untouched.
On leg, Beth Mooney looks to tuck it on the leg side. The ball goes off her thigh pad to fine leg. The batters take a single.
Good-length ball, on middle. Beth Mooney blocks it out.
Flighted ball on leg, Beth Mooney sweeps it to fine leg. She retains the strike by picking up a single.
Flatter ball, on middle. Beth Mooney works it on the leg side.
Tossed up, outside off. Beth Mooney pushes it to cover.
Slower and outside off, Beth Mooney punches it off the back foot towards covers.
Full and on middle, nudged to mid-wicket.
Short and on middle, Ellyse Perry pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Ellyse Perry steers it past point for a single.
Good-length ball, outside off. Pushed back to the bowler.
On middle, Ellyse Perry flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Outside off, Beth Mooney guides it towards deep backward point for a single.
On a good length, on off. Beth Mooney leans across and defends it on the off side.
Good-length ball, outside off, cut Beth Mooney in half. The ball went past the inside edge and carries through to the keeper.
Pooja Vastrakar is brought into the attack. She replaces Sneh Rana.
On middle and Mooney works it past the diving bowler and towards mid on for another one. 8 runs off it, a good one for Australia Women.
Shorter in length and around off. Perry goes on the back foot and nudges it to short third man. They get a run.
Flighted ball, on leg stump. Beth Mooney uses her feet and works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Mooney defends it on the off side.
Again it's short and wide. This time Perry cuts it straight to sweeper cover. Just a single then.
FOUR! Sharma starts with a long hop outside off. Perry has all the time in the world to hop back and cut it past sweeper cover for a boundary.
Deepti Sharma comes into the attack. She replaces Rajeshwari Gayakwad.
Flatter one, angled into middle stump. Mooney defends it out well.
Short again and Mooney cuts it straight to point.
Tossed up, outside off. Mooney leans forward and plays it to cover-point.
Dragged down on leg stump. Perry whips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Nicely flighted, on off. Perry uses her feet and works it to mid off.
Short and wide, cut away behind point for a couple of runs by Ellyse Perry.
Flighted ball, on off and driven through covers for a single.
Flatter delivery, around off and cut away to point.
Drifting it on the pads, Ellyse Perry looks to flick but misses. She gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up, outside off. Ellyse Perry rocks back and chops it to point.
On middle, punched to covers.
Beth Mooney walks out to bat.

OUT! RUN OUT! The dangerous Alyssa Healy has to depart! Loopy full toss, on off stump. Ellyse Perry steps out and hits it hard back towards the bowler. Rajeshwari Gayakwad tries to get a hand on it but can't collect it cleanly. The ball goes through the hands and takes the fingertips on the way and crashes into the stumps at the bowler's end. Alyssa Healy is out of her crease and the replay confirms this. India Women get a lucky breakthrough.
A run out appeal has been sent upstairs! Alyssa Healy is already walking off the field. Replay shows that the ball did deflect off Rajeshwari Gayakwad's hands and Alyssa Healy is well short.

SAFE! Flighted delivery, on middle stump and Healy just looks to turn it on the leg side. Healy closes the face of the bat a bit too early and gets the leading edge. The bowler and the fielder from short mid on try to reach it but the ball lands safely.
Shortish ball, outside off and cut away to cover-point.
Fullish ball, around off. Healy plays it on the off side.
Flatter delivery, on middle and Perry pushes it down the ground for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Perry defends it out.
On a length and on middle and leg. Healy works it off the back foot to deep square leg for a run.

DRINKS! Australia Women were looking good but two wickets in quick succession have put them on the back foot. The Aussies would now bank on Alyssa Healy who is looking in good touch and Ellyse Perry to stay long at the middle. India Women have kept the run flow in check and would look to get a couple of wickets more.
Down the leg side and Perry paddles it fine past short fine leg. They get a couple before the fielder cuts it off.
FOUR! Short and wide. Ellyse Perry rocks back and latches onto it in a flash. Perry cuts it to the vacant cover boundary.
On middle, pushed to mid on.
Flighted ball, around off. Perry plays a lovely cover drive but Mithali Raj dives to her right and cuts it off. No run taken.
Shorter delivery, outside off. Healy punches it off the back foot through covers for a single.
Tossed up delivery, Alyssa Healy steps out and plays it uppishly towards mid on.
Tad short and outside off, Alyssa Healy slaps it towards sweeper cover for one.
Flatter delivery, on off. The ball keeps a little low. Alyssa Healy stays on the back foot and manages to bring her bat down in time.
Flighted ball, on off. Alyssa Healy knocks it back to the bowler.
Flighted ball on middle, Ellyse Perry tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, on middle. Alyssa Healy knocks it to long on for a single.
Outside off, tapped to point.
Flighted ball, on off. Ellyse Perry taps it to point.
Outside off. Alyssa Healy cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad pulls back the length a bit and bowls it on middle stump. Healy punches it to mid on.
Flatter again and on middle, Perry goes deep in the crease and nudges it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter ball, on off stump. Perry rocks back and cuts it to cover-point.
Tossed up, on off and played towards cover.
Tossed up, on middle. Ellyse Perry skips down the track and eases it down to long on for one.
Loopy ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy dabs it to the right of Jhulan Goswami. She manages to half-stop it.
Flighted ball, on middle. Alyssa Healy glances it around the corner for a single.
Flatter ball on middle, Alyssa Healy pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller and wider, pushed to covers.
Floats it up, on leg. Ellyse Perry works it to deep square leg for a single.
Spin from both ends now as Sneh Rana comes into the attack.
Tossed up, outside off. Alyssa Healy dabs it down to third man for a couple of runs.
On middle, Alyssa Healy pushes it to mid on.
Floats it up, outside off. Ellyse Perry guides it to third man for a single.
Flatter ball on leg, nudged to mid on.
Full and on middle, Alyssa Healy steps out and drives it to long off for one.
Loopy ball, on middle. Alyssa Healy pushes it to cover off the front foot.
Length ball, around off. Ellyse Perry tries to defend but gets if off the inside edge on the leg side. Another maiden over!
On a good length, on off. Ellyse Perry blocks it out off the front foot.
On off, Perry taps it to point.
Good-length ball, on off. Ellyse Perry punches it towards covers.
Length ball, on off. Ellyse Perry pushes it towards covers.
Fuller in length, on middle. Ellyse Perry pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up again, on off and Healy works it to mid off. Rajeshwari Gayakwad starts off with a maiden.
A tad bit short and on leg stump. Healy rocks back and dabs it down to square leg.
Flighted ball, around off and pushed to the cover region.
Tossed up, on off. Healy plays it gently towards mid off.
Fired in, full and on off. Healy pushes it to covers.
Quicker and flatter, outside off. Left alone.
Spin time! Rajeshwari Gayakwad is introduced into the attack. She replaces Meghna Singh.
On off and pushed to mid off. Excellent over from Jhulan Goswami, a double-wicket maiden!
Ellyse Perry is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Jhulan Goswami has got the Australia Women skipper, Meg Lanning for a duck! Goswami continues to pitch it up and look for the swing and gets just a hint of away movement. Meg Lanning is tempted to play the cover drive and she goes for it. Lanning only manages to get a thick outside edge and the ball flies to the right of the keeper. Richa Ghosh dives to her right and takes a very sharp catch. Two down now for Australia Women and India Women are back in it.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Jhulan Goswami

Commentary.Commentary: Full again, on off and nipping in. Lanning drives it to mid off.
Full and on that sixth stump line. Meg Lanning leaves it alone.
Pitched up, on middle. Lanning pushes it to mid on.
The skipper, Meg Lanning walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Here comes the first breakthrough and Jhulan Goswami is the one who provides it yet again. Length ball, around off and Rachael Haynes looks to be aggressive and hit it downtown. She loses grip of her bat while lifting it high and towards mid off and the bat slips out of her hands in the end as well. Shafali Verma settles under it and takes a simple catch. The umpire checks whether it was a legal delivery and Jhulan Goswami did have some part of the boot behind the line.
Commentary.Howout: c Shafali Verma b Jhulan Goswami

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, outside off and nipping away. Left alone by Alyssa Healy. 13 runs from the over, a good one for Australia Women.
Good-length ball, around off, tapped to cover-point.
WIDE! Singh tries to bowl wide outside off but this one is a bit too wide. Left alone and wide called.

FOUR! Alyssa Healy is on a roll now and everybody nows how dangerous she is while in full flow. Short of a length, on middle and Healy pulls it to the mid-wicket fence with authority. Third boundary in the over.
FOUR! Great timing from Alyssa Healy. Fullish ball, by no means a half-volley and Healy leans into the cover drive. She gets it through extra cover and picks up a boundary.
Length ball, on top of off. Alyssa Healy stays solid in defense.
FOUR! This one is short and wide. Alyssa Healy cuts it away very fine, off the bottom edge and the ball beats third man. Healy picks up another boundary.
FOUR! Goswami pitches it up again and finally Rachael Haynes breaks the shackles. She thumps it to the left of mid on and the ball races into the fence.
Good-length ball, on middle. Haynes pushes it to mid on.

Edged...but safe! Jhulan Goswami pitches this one up and allows the ball to swing, Alyssa Healy is suckered into the drive. She gets a thick outside edge which goes through second slip and towards third man. They get one.
Back of a length, around off. Rachael Haynes steers it through point for a single.
And again! This time it's a bit fuller and the ball just beats the outside edge as Rachael Haynes looks to have a poke at it. Lovely bowling this from Jhulan Goswami.
BEAUTY! On a length and just outside off, the ball shapes away and zips past the outside edge of Rachael Haynes's bat.
FOUR! Attempted short ball from Meghna Singh, just not short enough. Alyssa Healy latches onto it in a flash and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On middle and this one is defended off the front foot by Alyssa Healy.
A tad short and wide. Alyssa Healy rocks back and cuts it straight to cover-point.
Length ball, on off and shaping away. Pushed to the cover region.
LEG BYE! Good-length ball, on leg and shaping in. Haynes looks to tuck but misses. She gets it off the thigh pads onto the leg side. They get a leg bye.
A quick short ball, outside off. Rachael Haynes looks to pull but misses it completely.
An outswinger, outside off, at 110 kph. Alyssa Healy lets it sail through.

Good-length ball, on off, angling in. Alyssa Healy looks to defend but is beaten by the extra bounce. She gets hit on the thigh pad. Muted appeal from Jhulan Goswami for an LBW but the umpire shakes his head.

FOUR! Streaky runs! Good-length ball, around the fifth stump channel, Alyssa Healy looks to defend. The ball goes off the outside edge and flies past the first slip fielder. The ball races away to the third man fence.
A tempter from Goswami outside off, Alyssa Healy looks to drive but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge and carries through to the keeper.
Good-length ball, on off. Alyssa Healy pats it back to the bowler.
Good-length ball, on off, jagging back in. Alyssa Healy stands tall and punches it to mid on.
Length ball, outside off, at 111.8 kph. Rachael Haynes with soft hands pushes it towards covers. She looks for a quick single but Alyssa Healy sends her back and rightly so.
Length ball, outside off, Rachael Haynes taps it towards point.
On a length around off, Rachael Haynes blocks it out on the off side.
Outside off, pushed to covers.
Full again, on leg, nipping in. Rachael Haynes clips it to mid-wicket.
Full and too straight, on middle. Alyssa Healy clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Five dots in a row! Length ball on off, Rachael Haynes prods and blocks it out. Superb over from Jhulan Goswami. Just the single from it.
On a length, around off. Rachael Haynes firmly defends it back to the bowler.
Good-length ball, on middle. Rachael Haynes tries to defend but inside-edges it onto the pads.
A little fuller this time, on middle and leg. Rachael Haynes nudges it to mid-wicket.
Length ball, on the sixth stump channel. Rachael Haynes leaves it for the keeper to collect.
Good-length ball, outside off. Alyssa Healy hits it uppishly towards deep point for a single.
On a length, outside off. Driven straight to covers. A good over for Australia Women. 7 runs from it.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full and outside off, Rachael Haynes leans onto it and creams it through covers. The ball races away to the fence in a flash.
Good-length ball, on off. Rachael Haynes keeps it out on the off side.
Length ball, outside off. Pushed to covers.
On a length, on off. Alyssa Healy was in two minds there, whether to play or leave. But she gets away with it as she taps it off the bottom half of the bat towards point. A single.
Back of a length, on off. Alyssa Healy hops and punches it off the back foot through covers. The fielder gives it a chase and keeps it to two.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's going to be Meghna Singh.
Length ball, outside off. Rachael Haynes drives it but finds the fielder at extra cover. 4 runs from the first over.
Good leave from Haynes! Good-length ball, on off, nipping back in. Rachael Haynes watches the ball closely and shoulders arms.
Good-length ball, on middle. Rachael Haynes puts a stride forward and blocks it out.
On a length on middle, Haynes defends it out to mid-wicket.

FOUR! A nice little gift from Jhulan Goswami. She bowls a full-length ball, on leg. Rachael Haynes simply tickles it away to fine leg for a boundary. Australia Women and Rachael Haynes are up and running!
Goswami starts with a good-length ball, outside off, swinging away. Haynes leaves it alone.

We are all set for play. The umpires stride out to the middle along with the India Women players. Rachael Haynes and Alyssa Healy are the openers for Australia Women. Jhulan Goswami to start proceedings with the ball.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Rachael Haynes (In for Georgia Wareham), Alyssa Healy (WK), Meg Lanning (C), Ellyse Perry, Beth Mooney, Ashleigh Gardner, Tahlia McGrath, Nicola Carey, Annabel Sutherland (In for Darcie Brown), Sophie Molineux, Stella Campbell (In for Hannah Darlington).

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Yastika Bhatia, Mithali Raj (C), Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh (WK), Pooja Vastrakar, Jhulan Goswami, Meghna Singh, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Sheh Rana (In for Poonam Yadav).
TOSS - Australia Women have won the toss and they will have a BAT first.
Early news from the middle is that the 19-year-old pacer, Stella Campbell, has received her ODI cap and is set to make her international debut.

Australia Women and India Women are set to lock horns once again in the third and final ODI. Australia Women comfortably won the first ODI but in the second ODI, were put under immense pressure as chasing 275, the side lost 4 wickets with not many runs on the board. However, Meg Lanning-led side won the match and extended their winning streak in this format to 26. India Women batted really well last time and though they lost crucial points in the series, they would look to end the ODIs on a high and break the winning streak of the visitors. On the other hand, the home team will look to extend their winning streak. On that note, welcome to the coverage. Stay tuned as we bring you all the updates.
